Details 
 This trucker hat is crafted from 100% cotton canvas and features a 3-D embroidered rider motif and Stetson Co. logo. It has a gently curved bill and an adjustable snapback closure for a secure fit. Truckers throughout the 20th-century wore caps branded with their company’s logo—by the ‘70s, they had evolved into the hat we know and appreciate today. Practical, proud, and pure Americana, the trucker hat is a true classic.
